scope: Read-only source/documentation review; no HA changes, device access, installation, build or firmware test

recommendation.first_prototype: ESPHome native API with a version-pinned local override of esp32_ble_server
recommendation.reason: Existing Builder and native HA buttons can be reused. Core GATT configuration and notification actions already exist, but stock 2026.9.1 needs targeted fixes for duplicate report UUIDs and security callbacks.
recommendation.fallback: Arduino + NimBLE-Arduino 2.5.1 HID server + MQTT buttons if ESPHome reconnect/subscription handling becomes a substantial custom implementation
recommendation.reliability_status: Neither route has been tested against this speaker; no success guarantee

esphome.duplicate_uuid_fix: ADD_CHAR_EVT must match current CREATING instance, non-null service, event service_handle, last_created_characteristic and UUID; handle failure status. A last_created-only condition is insufficient.
esphome.security_gap: Register GAP security callback; respond to SEC_REQ, initiate encryption where required, track authentication outcome and gate report notification.
esphome.security_change_estimate: 60-100 lines before implementation/compilation, excluding CCCD persistence
esphome.local_override: Copy the pinned component's 13 files; initially modify __init__.py, ble_server.h, ble_server.cpp and ble_characteristic.cpp. Scope override only to the new device YAML.
esphome.cccd_gap: Notification subscribers are stored in RAM by connection ID; ordinary disconnect does not clear them, while service deletion/reboot loses them. Clear stale connection entries and verify whether JBL re-subscribes after reconnect. If not, restore CCCD state by bonded identity.
esphome.permission_gap: Stock characteristic permissions are READ|WRITE without a public setter; encrypted attribute permissions require another small interface/schema extension if exact permission fidelity is needed.

hid_capabilities: setReportMap accepts the original byte array
getInputReport creates separate 0x2A4D characteristics by report ID
input reports and references use READ_ENC
notify can send an explicit pointer and byte length
nimble.security: Explicitly enable bonding after init; configure NoInputNoOutput and SC support according to pairing evidence. Do not inherit the default bonding=false configuration.
nimble.ha_transport: MQTT button command topics and availability are simpler than implementing the ESPHome native API protocol inside standalone Arduino firmware. Use non-retained commands and explicit press/release scheduling.

implementation_gates: Identify the ESP32 board and confirm Wi-Fi plus BLE support before selecting build target.
Capture Report Reference descriptors before treating original ATT handles as report IDs.
Preserve measured 8-byte and 2-byte notification payloads; do not silently pad the 2-byte stream to the Report Map's four bytes.
Use the emulator's own BLE address and pair it through the speaker's normal pairing procedure; do not assume copied MAC or original bond keys are needed.
Verify initial pairing, one input switch, one volume action, release behavior, speaker reconnect and ESP power-cycle bond recovery before expanding the complete button set.
